fields.title: Unified Inventory Management System (Java & SQL)
fields.description: Developed a desktop application to manage product stock, categories, and suppliers. Focuses on OOP and database connectivity. Key Features: CRUD operations using Java JDBC to connect to an Oracle Database. Technical Highlight: Applied Encapsulation and Inheritance. Managed version control using Git branches.

fields.title: Automated Banking Transaction Engine (PL/SQL & Oracle)
fields.description: Built a database-level engine to handle bank account operations like transfers, deposits, and withdrawals. Key Features: Created PL/SQL Procedures to validate balances and Triggers for automated audit logs. Technical Highlight: Used Complex SQL Joins and optimized performance by indexing primary/foreign keys.

fields.title: Student Enrollment & Grade Portal (Java & Relational Theory)
fields.description: Designed a system to manage university enrollments, mapping relationships between students, courses, and professors. Key Features: Designed the relational schema from scratch, ensuring 3rd Normal Form (3NF). Technical Highlight: Implemented a Java interface handling many-to-many relationships via intermediate tables.

fields.title: Personal Finance CLI Tool (Java & Git Workflow)
fields.description: A Command Line Interface (CLI) tool that allows users to track monthly expenses and export reports. Key Features: Uses file handling or a local Oracle instance to persist data. Technical Highlight: Demonstrated advanced Git usage with clean commit history and comprehensive README documentation.
